taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-05 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 26.6 | 4.30 | 4.30
2 | 119.1 | 2.37 | 6.67
3 | 340.4 | 0.77 | 7.44
4 | 640.3 | 0.77 | 8.21
5 | 2441.4 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-05
Curve type: A-type (resistivity increases progressively with depth: ρ1<ρ2<ρ3<ρ4<ρ5)
Aquifer depth: 4.30 – 6.67 m (weathered/fractured zone, 119.1 ohm‑m layer)

Recommendation: Target the weathered zone between 4.3 m and 6.7 m depth as the primary water‑bearing horizon; drill through this interval with proper casing to prevent collapse, and terminate before the underlying resistive, likely low‑yield competent bedrock (>340 ohm‑m) unless deeper fracture zones are confirmed during drilling.
